message.content: The viscous friction force depends on the angular velocity and the damping coefficient: Damping. Damping should be included for the physical pendulum model when the motion is damped: Case. Case means adding a damping force or torque proportional to angular velocity: Model. Model that force or torque as the damping coefficient times the angular velocity, with opposite sign.
